verification.note: ios/Litloft/Share/ServerAddress.swift:3 defines `enum ServerAddress`. project.pbxproj:321 compiles it in a Sources phase (the extension's, per the finding), and ServerSettings.swift:17 and ShareSheetModel.swift:72 use it. The touch points do not list this file. The move is an unlisted but behaviour-neutral refactor needed so the extension can share the parser.

Shared.xcconfig:17 defines LITLOFT_KEYCHAIN_GROUP. Both entitlements files contain keychain-access-groups. Litloft-Info.plist:18 and LitloftShare/Info.plist:25 hold the LITLOFTKeychainGroup key. These are unlisted surfaces. Litloft-Info.plist has no NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription, as claimed. However, project.pbxproj:404 and :434 set INFOPLIST_KEY_NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription for the app, so the app does get the key, through build settings instead of the plist file. The literal claim is true; the functional impact is nil.
